gaps.message: The NFR-10 and NFR-12 cases (lines 512-543) are whole-suite criteria. They are kept as report-reading tests only because TEST_INVENTORY declares the names, and the spec itself flags them for Agent B. They are weak verifiers but acceptable. The consistency gate also lists 224 predicates as needing Agent B review. These are not contradictions.

NFR-03 case 1 sets a 5 s response deadline for /readyz when the database is down. SRS only says 'not retried infinitely', so the bound is the catalog's own and should be confirmed in P3. The same applies to the `;` and `$` injection-blacklist assumption (NFR-99.2).

The header cites '99 AC' and '99 tc_ids', but the file has 143 cases (111 named rows plus 32 Deferred). The extra rows come from SEC-forced and sub-rows. A grep for 'tc_id' in TEST_INVENTORY.yaml returned 100 matches, which may include a header line. I did not confirm the count.
